verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes an llms.txt at secureframe.com/llms.txt (docs-48), and its MCP docs (docs-37, docs-38, docs-58, docs-59) are written for agents, explaining how MCP clients like Claude Code and Cursor connect and authenticate. A full machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0 definition is also embedded in the API reference (supp-openapi-embedded). However, the only quoted llms.txt content is marketing copy, so it is unclear whether it indexes developer or API docs. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt covers API/MCP developer docs, an llms-full.txt or raw OpenAPI download URL, and independent or hands-on confirmation that agents can consume these docs effectively.
